findings.message: redemptionRate typed as double — contract specifies Double/percentage 0-100. Intentional per contract.
currency_type SQL column alias mismatch with currencyId DTO field name
AccessDeniedException message leaked internal feature flag key name
region filter logged verbatim — potential log injection
Missing log.warn when lastRefreshedAt is null in getItemBreakdown
Cache poisoning: @Cacheable on getItemBreakdown bypasses requireFeatureEnabled() on cache hit. Feature flag check must be outside the cached boundary.
region field has no length/pattern constraint at DTO level
region logged verbatim — log injection risk
Missing @ApiResponse annotations for 403/422 on item-breakdown endpoint

contract-compliance.note: GET /item-breakdown endpoint matches contract schema. Tier filter (contract parameter) not yet implemented — by story design (US-01 scope is region only). Multi-value region is a contract extension deferred per spec.

findings.summary: Cache TTL defaults to 30 minutes — advanced-analytics-item-breakdown not in RedisConfig
findings.details: RedisConfig only registers 'redemption-analytics' with 60s TTL; the new 'advanced-analytics-item-breakdown' cache falls back to the 30-minute default. AC-4 specifies 60-second TTL.
findings.tierReason: adversarial-review in $SOFT_STAGES → advisory regardless of severity
findings.recommendation: Add 'advanced-analytics-item-breakdown' cache entry with Duration.ofSeconds(60) to RedisConfig.

findings.summary: Feature-flag gate bypassed by @Cacheable — cache hit skips requireFeatureEnabled()
findings.details: Spring @Cacheable resolves key and checks cache before entering the method body. A cache hit returns the cached ItemBreakdownResponse without calling requireFeatureEnabled(). A tenant with a revoked feature flag receives cached analytics for up to 60 seconds after revocation.
findings.tierReason: adversarial-review in $SOFT_STAGES → advisory regardless of severity
findings.recommendation: Move feature-flag enforcement to an uncached public wrapper method; delegate to a package-private @Cacheable method for the actual query.

findings.summary: totalRedeemedCount maps to COUNT(*) (all statuses), not completed-only
findings.details: MV column total_redeemed_count = COUNT(*) over all redemption statuses (PENDING, PROCESSING, FAILED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED). The contract field 'totalRedeemedCount' is described as 'Total number of completed redemptions.' Items with many PENDING/FAILED requests are overstated in the ranking.
findings.tierReason: adversarial-review in $SOFT_STAGES → advisory regardless of severity
findings.recommendation: Add completed_count column to MV (new Flyway migration), or compute SUM(total_redeemed_count - failed_count - cancelled_count) in the query as a proxy. Update contract/spec to clarify semantics if the intent is 'all attempts'.

findings.summary: tier filter silently ignored; region multi-value contract not implemented
findings.details: Controller binds only region as a single string. Contract advertises tier as a comma-separated multi-value filter. Spring silently drops unrecognised query params so callers believe their tier filter is applied.
findings.tierReason: medium severity → advisory; also adversarial-review in $SOFT_STAGES
findings.recommendation: Add tier parameter or document in error/API that tier is not yet supported. Multi-value region and tier to be addressed in a later story.

classificationRules.blockingThreshold: severity critical/high AND confidence >= 0.70 AND not alreadyHandled — but step is in $SOFT_STAGES so all findings are advisory
classificationRules.advisoryThreshold: severity medium/low OR confidence < 0.70 OR alreadyHandled OR step in softStages

# Codex Adversarial Review

Target: branch diff against features/redemption-analytics-advanced
Verdict: needs-attention

No-ship: the endpoint can serve stale/flag-revoked analytics from cache and its core count metric overstates completed redemptions.

Findings:
- [high] Feature flag gate is behind a 30-minute cache — cache hit bypasses requireFeatureEnabled()
- [high] totalRedeemedCount reports all requests (COUNT(*)), not completed redemptions per contract
- [medium] Segment filters (tier, multi-value region) missing or silently ignored

advisory_findings.summary: Feature-flag gate bypassed by @Cacheable — requires uncached wrapper method
advisory_findings.recommendation: Move requireFeatureEnabled() outside cached method boundary

advisory_findings.summary: totalRedeemedCount maps COUNT(*) (all statuses) — contract says completed-only
advisory_findings.recommendation: Add completed_count column to MV or compute in service query; clarify contract semantics

advisory_findings.summary: tier filter and multi-value region not implemented (contract gap)
advisory_findings.recommendation: Document as deferred or implement in a follow-on story
